capabilities.summary: Hooks dispatched from the settings hooks map; stdin JSON in, stdout JSON/plain out; PreToolUse and UserPromptSubmit can deny-and-block; Stop can force continuation; no external wake.

native_events.notes: stdout (plain or JSON additionalContext) is added to the session's opening context; matcher values source/startup/resume.
exit 2 blocks the prompt; stdout (plain or JSON additionalContext) is added to the turn context.
exit 2 denies the tool call for this invocation; JSON hookSpecificOutcome.additionalContext is the pre-tool context channel (not stdout text).
runs after tool success; exit 2 shows stderr to the model (advisory), it cannot undo the tool result.
JSON decision block forces the model to continue instead of stopping; stdout is not injected as context.
cleanup only; the session is already terminating.
stdout becomes a custom instruction carried into the compacted context.
outbound: fires when the harness sends a notification (permission needed, idle prompt).

injection_channel.mechanism: JSON hookSpecificOutcome.additionalContext on stdout for PreToolUse; plain stdout (or JSON additionalContext) added to context at session-start, user-prompt-submit and pre-compact; exit 2 stderr is the deny channel, never a context channel.
injection_channel.notes: Pre-tool context must travel hookSpecificOutcome.additionalContext; text printed to stdout outside the JSON outcome is not the pre-tool channel.

blocking_semantics.notes: PreToolUse and UserPromptSubmit exit 2 (or JSON decision block with reason) deny the operation; Stop JSON decision block forces continuation. The dispatcher's gate phase rides exit codes and JSON decisions.

wake_capability.notes: hooks execute only inside a running session; nothing declared here wakes the harness from outside. Notification is the harness asking for attention, not accepting a wake.

install_seam.entry_shape: hooks.<EventName>[] entries, each {matcher?, hooks: [{type: "command", command, timeout?}]}
install_seam.ownership_marker: hook command resolves to the AIKit dispatch executable

uninstall_seam.entry_shape: hooks.<EventName>[] entries whose command matches the ownership marker are removed; entries without the marker are untouched
uninstall_seam.ownership_marker: hook command resolves to the AIKit dispatch executable

capabilities.summary: Per-project hooks.json covers SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, PreCompact, SessionEnd and the subagent/permission events; hook JSON output carries hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; PreToolUse permissionDecision deny vetoes the tool call; config.toml notify still invokes an external program at turn completion.

native_events.notes: shipped 0.155.1 hook output wire schema declares SessionStartHookSpecificOutputWire.additionalContext (default null).
UserPromptSubmitHookSpecificOutputWire.additionalContext declared in the shipped schema; no deny channel observed for this event.

PreToolUseHookSpecificOutputWire declares additionalContext and permissionDecision; the engine refuses permissionDecision:deny without a non-empty permissionDecisionReason, so deny blocks the tool call.
PostToolUseHookSpecificOutputWire declares additionalContext and updatedMCPToolOutput; no veto observed.
Stop is a declared hook event in the shipped schema; no continuation-forcing output channel is evidenced.
declared hook event in the shipped schema; cleanup-side.
declared hook event in the shipped schema; no injection behaviour evidenced.
SubagentStartHookSpecificOutputWire.additionalContext declared in the shipped schema.
declared hook event in the shipped schema.
the hook engine records a denied approval ('PermissionRequest hook denied approval'); the event gates approvals, not context.

injection_channel.mechanism: the hook process returns a JSON document on stdout whose hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext is added to context on SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse and SubagentStart (shipped hook output wire schema, codex-cli 0.155.1).
injection_channel.notes: correction of the 0.153.0 declared absence: 0.155.1 grows the additional-context channel this descriptor said to re-declare against.

blocking_semantics.notes: PreToolUse permissionDecision:deny (with non-empty permissionDecisionReason) vetoes the tool call; PermissionRequest can deny an approval. A dispatch gate rides the hook decision.

wake_capability.notes: unchanged by the correction: hooks and notify execute inside or beside a running session; nothing observed wakes the harness from outside. A relay sender must not pretend codex can be woken.

install_seam.entry_shape: per-event hook command entries under camelCase event names (SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit / PreToolUse / PostToolUse / Stop / PreCompact / SessionEnd / SubagentStart / SubagentStop / PermissionRequest); notify listener configured separately in config.toml; hook trust state recorded in hooks.state
install_seam.ownership_marker: hook command resolves to the AIKit dispatch executable

uninstall_seam.entry_shape: entries whose command matches the ownership marker are removed; foreign entries and config.toml notify are untouched
uninstall_seam.ownership_marker: hook command resolves to the AIKit dispatch executable

credential.hint: OpenAI API key or an active ChatGPT sign-in session

providers.notes: model is named by the config-key selector in config.toml; Actuation does not enumerate OpenAI's model catalogue here.

capabilities.summary: Seven native hook events (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, Stop); stdout JSON additionalContext; exit 2 denies pre-tool and permission boundaries; configuration-file hooks need hooks.enabled, plugin hooks auto-enable; no PreCompact, no Notification, no external wake.

native_events.notes: matcher value is the session mode: startup, resume, clear or compact.
matcher value is the prompt text; stdout JSON additionalContext joins the turn.
exit 2 is a deny for this invocation; the hook may also return a permission decision of allow/ask/deny. additionalContext is injected.
runs after tool success; advisory.
the hook may request continuation, up to three times.
no AIKit boundary kind; exit 2 denies the permission request. Declared so consumers see the whole native surface.
no AIKit boundary kind; fires after a failed tool call.

injection_channel.mechanism: hook stdout is parsed as a strict JSON schema; additionalContext is injected into the conversation. Exit codes carry the deny channel: 0 pass, 2 block, other non-zero error.
injection_channel.notes: the schema is strict — any extra key fails validation, so a projection must emit exactly the admitted fields.

blocking_semantics.notes: PreToolUse and PermissionRequest accept exit-2 denies; Stop accepts bounded continuation requests.

wake_capability.notes: hooks run inside a live session only; there is no Notification event and no external wake channel.

install_seam.entry_shape: top-level hooks block: { enabled: true, events: { <Event>: [ { matcher?, hooks: [{type: "command", command, ...}] } ] } }; configuration-file hooks stay disabled until hooks.enabled is true
install_seam.ownership_marker: hook command resolves to the AIKit dispatch executable

uninstall_seam.entry_shape: entries whose command matches the ownership marker are removed and empty event keys pruned; foreign hooks and every other top-level key are untouched
uninstall_seam.ownership_marker: hook command resolves to the AIKit dispatch executable

capabilities.summary: Per-invocation CLI/TUI agent; additional context travels as skill capsules projected into the skills tree and read at session start; extensions install into settings.json; no observed stdout/JSON context channel, no deny-and-block, no wake.

injection_channel.mechanism: no stdout/JSON context-injection channel is observed on pi 0.84.4. Additional context travels as skill capsules projected into the skills tree — ~/.pi/agent/skills globally, .pi/skills project-relative — and read at session start; a running TUI picks changes up with /reload, and a fresh invocation is the guaranteed pickup. Dispatch projections must use the skills seam declared in install_seam, never stdout.
injection_channel.notes: pi also carries an extension surface (pi install writes into settings.json); no extension event grammar is observed in Actuation's receipts, so none is declared here. Re-declare this descriptor when a pi release grows an additional-context channel.

blocking_semantics.notes: no per-call blocking surface is observed: tool allowlists (--tools/--exclude-tools/--no-tools) are invocation flags set at launch, not dispatch hooks.

wake_capability.notes: pi is per-invocation: nothing declared here wakes a running session or a closed one. A relay sender must not pretend pi can be woken.

install_seam.entry_shape: one directory per skill capsule, each carrying a SKILL.md front-matter document; the capsule name is the directory name
install_seam.ownership_marker: capsule directories written by the AIKit pi projection (aikit:pi-adapter); foreign skill directories are untouched

uninstall_seam.entry_shape: capsule directories whose name matches a capsule the projection wrote are removed; directories without the ownership marker are untouched
uninstall_seam.ownership_marker: capsule directories written by the AIKit pi projection (aikit:pi-adapter); foreign skill directories are untouched

model_dispatch.notes: pi is provider-plural by design: provider and model are chosen per invocation (--provider/--model) or via settings defaultProvider/defaultModel (observed: deepseek on this machine), with credentials resolved through pi's own auth surface. No single provider binding is admitted here and Actuation does not enumerate pi's provider catalogue.

injection_channel.mechanism: no stdout/JSON context-injection channel is declared for prime 0.9.4. injection_channel.notes: prime also exposes --mode rpc (the AIKit Prime RPC encounter transport) and RLM child recursion; neither is an injection channel and neither is declared here.

blocking_semantics.notes: no per-call blocking surface is declared: tool allowlists (-t/--tools, -nt, -nbt) are invocation flags set at launch, not dispatch hooks.

wake_capability.notes: prime is per-invocation with an opt-in daemon; nothing declared here wakes a running session. A relay sender must not pretend prime can be woken.

install_seam.config_path: per-launch argv (--skill <capsule-dir>); no on-disk projection seam is declared because prime's skill-discovery paths are unverified on this install
install_seam.entry_shape: one directory per skill capsule, each carrying a SKILL.md front-matter document, passed to the launch as --skill <dir>
install_seam.ownership_marker: capsule directories written by the AIKit prime projection

uninstall_seam.config_path: per-launch argv (--skill <capsule-dir>); removing a projection means dropping the capsule from the launch argv, so nothing foreign is ever touched
